accept.name: theme-band-dark
accept.css: position: relative; overflow: hidden; & > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } &::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 22px 22px; -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(80% 100% at 50% 50%, #000 0%, transparent 80%); mask-image: radial-gradient(80% 100% at 50% 50%, #000 0%, transparent 80%); } & .wp-block-button.is-style-outline .wp-block-button__link { color: var(--wp--preset--color--surface); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); }

accept.name: theme-card
accept.css: height: 100%; transition: box-shadow 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; &:hover { border-color: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.35); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.25); transform: translateY(-2px); }

accept.name: theme-check-line
accept.css: position: relative; padding: 6px 0 6px 30px; &::before { content: "\2713"; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 6px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--wp--preset--color--surface-accent); color: var(--wp--preset--color--accent); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

accept.name: theme-check-list
accept.css: list-style: none; padding: 0; & li { position: relative; padding: 6px 0 6px 30px; } & li::before { content: "\2713"; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 6px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--wp--preset--color--surface-accent); color: var(--wp--preset--color--accent); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

accept.name: theme-docs-nav
accept.css: list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; & li { margin: 0; } & a { display: block; padding: 6px 12px; border-left: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--wp--preset--color--text-muted); text-decoration: none; } & a:hover { color: var(--wp--preset--color--ink); } & a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--wp--preset--color--accent); border-left-color: var(--wp--preset--color--accent); font-weight: 600; }

accept.name: theme-hero
accept.css: position: relative; overflow: hidden; & > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } &::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(20, 20, 31, 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 22px 22px; -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(70% 90% at 50% 0%, #000 0%, transparent 75%); mask-image: radial-gradient(70% 90% at 50% 0%, #000 0%, transparent 75%); } &::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background: radial-gradient(60% 80% at 50% 0%, rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.09) 0%, rgba(79, 70, 229, 0) 70%); }

accept.name: theme-icon-tile
accept.css: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px;

accept.name: theme-price
accept.css: & small { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--wp--preset--color--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0; }

accept.name: theme-screenshot
accept.css: overflow: hidden; background: var(--wp--preset--color--surface); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(20, 20, 31, 0.25), 0 4px 16px rgba(20, 20, 31, 0.06); & img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 11px; }

reject.name: legacy-execution

reject.name: unknown-function
reject.because: a function that is not on the allow list is refused, not ignored

reject.name: attr-function

reject.name: unterminated-string

reject.name: comment

reject.name: ampersand-in-a-value

reject.name: declaration-after-a-rule

reject.name: unclosed-rule

reject.name: not-a-declaration
